questions.question: If (tan θ + cot θ) = 4, then (tan 2 θ + cot 2 θ) is यदि (tan θ + cot θ) = 4 है, तो (tan 2 θ + cot 2 θ) का मान है-
questions.solution:
(tan θ + cot θ)² = 16

tan² θ + cot 2θ + 2 tan θ cot θ = 16

tan2 θ + cot2 θ = 14

questions.question: if 5n= secQ and 5/n= tanQ find the value of 5(n 2 -1/n 2 ) यदि 5n= secQ और 5/n= tanQ है, तो 5(n 2 -1/n 2 ) का मान ज्ञात करें|
questions.solution:
secQ = 5n

=> n = secQ/5

tanQ = 5/n

=> 1/n = tanQ/5

5(n2 - 1/n2) = 5 [sec2 Q/25 - tan2 Q/25] = 5 x 1/25 = 1/5

questions.solution:
x/2 = y/7 = z/9 = k (let)

Then, x = 2k, = 7k,z = 9k

then, (x+y+z)2/ xz

= (2k+7k+9k)2/18k2

= 324k2/ 18k2 = 18

questions.question: The value of sin 2 10° + sin 2 20° + sin 2 30° + .. + sin 2 90° is sin 2 10° + sin 2 20° + sin 2 30° + .. + sin 2 90° का मान है-
questions.questionHtml:
The value of sin2 10° + sin2 20° + sin2 30° + .. + sin2 90° is

sin2 10° + sin2 20° + sin2 30° + .. + sin2 90° का मान है-
questions.solution:
We know sin(90° - A) = cos A

Therefore, sin2 10° + sin2 20° + sin2 30° + .. + sin2 90°

= sin2 10° + sin2 20° + sin2 30° + sin2 40° + cos2 40° + cos2 30° + cos2 20° + cos2 10° + sin2 90°

= (sin2 10° + cos2 10°) + (sin2 20° + cos2 20°) + (sin2 30° + cos2 30°) + (sin2 40° + cos2 40°) + sin2 90°

= 1+1+1+1+1 = 5

questions.question: In the given figure AD || BC, find the value of x. दिए गये आरेख में AD || BC है, तो x का मान ज्ञात करें|
questions.questionHtml:
In the given figure AD || BC, find the value of x.

दिए गये आरेख में AD || BC है, तो x का मान ज्ञात करें|

questions.solution:
Area of rhombus = 0.5*d1*d2 (d1, d2 are the length of the diagonals)

=> 120=0.5*d1*d2

=> d2=10 (as d1= 24)

=> Now AC = 24, Therefore AO=12

=> BD=10, Therefore BO=5

=> In right angled triangle AOB

=> AO2+BO2=AB2

=> 122+52=AB2

=> AB=13

questions.question: In a ΔABC, AB 2 + AC 2 = BC 2 and BC = √2AB, then ∠ABC is एक ΔABC में, AB 2 + AC 2 = BC 2 और BC = √2AB, तो ∠ABC है_
questions.questionHtml:
In a ΔABC, AB2 + AC2 = BC2 and BC = √2AB, then ∠ABC is

एक ΔABC में, AB2 + AC2 = BC2 और BC = √2AB, तो ∠ABC है_
questions.solution:
In a ΔABC,

AB2 + AC2 = BC2 ..(i)

Δ ABC is a right angled triangle and

∠BAC = 90°

And BC = √2 AB ..(ii)

From eqs. (i) and (ii),

AB2 + AC2 = 2AB2

=> AC2 = AB2 => AC = AB

=> ΔABC is an isosceles triangle.

Hence, ∠ABC = ∠ACB = 45°

questions.question: If tan A = 1 - cos B _________ sin B , then tan 2A is equal to: यदि tan A = 1 - cos B _________ sin B , है, तो tan 2A बराबर है:
questions.questionHtml:
If tan A =  
1 - cos B_________sin B
 , then tan 2A is equal to: 

यदि tan A =  
1 - cos B_________sin B
 , है, तो tan 2A बराबर है:
questions.solution:
tan A =  
1 - cos B_________sin B
  =  
2 sin2 (B/2)_________2 sin (B/2) cos (B/2)
  =  
sin (B/2)_________cos (B/2)

= tan (B/2)

So, A = B/2 and 2A = B

so tan (2A) = tan B
